purpose: Inventory of PSDK local persistence that defines the safe JSON boundary. It does not enable remote restoration.

entries.identity: The local GamePlay::Save byte stream, beginning with the configured DUNCR header.
entries.type: Header plus a Ruby Marshal payload, optionally XOR-transformed by saveKey.
entries.restrictions: Never accept Marshal data from a remote source. A nonzero saveKey is reversible obfuscation, not encryption.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState, the root local state object.
entries.type: Ruby object graph with globals, map state, player state, and plugin extensions.
entries.restrictions: Do not encode the object graph directly. Rebuild only from independently validated entries, then call the runtime load lifecycle.

entries.type: Boolean values indexed by switch ID.
entries.restrictions: Keep explicit false values; omission is not equivalent to false.
entries.evidence: RMXP global state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.type: Integer values indexed by variable ID.
entries.restrictions: Preserve IDs, values, defaults, and out-of-range access semantics. Reject values outside the supported integer domain.
entries.evidence: RMXP global state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Game_SelfSwitches keyed by map, event, and switch.
entries.type: Boolean values keyed by a composite event identity.
entries.restrictions: Use an ordered tuple [map_id, event_id, switch_id]; never stringify the key.
entries.evidence: RMXP event state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Project self variables keyed by map, event, and variable.
entries.type: Composite keys with values that may be Ruby objects.
entries.restrictions: Reject until an adapter defines reversible tuple keys and an explicit allowlist of value types.
entries.evidence: Project self-variable extension and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Trainer profile, party, actors, stored Critters, inventory, Bestiary, and quests.
entries.type: PSDK domain objects with cross-references and game-data identifiers.
entries.restrictions: Use versioned adapters with explicit IDs and scalar fields. Reject unknown species, moves, items, quest states, and cross-references.

entries.identity: Persistent system, screen, and player data including map position and direction.
entries.restrictions: Encode only documented persistent fields such as map ID, coordinates, direction, timer, and restrictions. Exclude live graphics and callbacks.

entries.identity: Current map definitions, event pages, followers, and selected event state.
entries.type: Map resources plus transient Game_Event instances.
entries.restrictions: Reload map definitions from the installed game and restore only the explicitly captured event state. Do not serialize live Game_Event objects.

entries.type: Environment state separate from a live event object.
entries.restrictions: Preserve map and event IDs. Verify behavior after map setup; do not infer that every runtime erase is persistent.

entries.identity: Map, battle, and parallel-event interpreter progress.
entries.type: Instruction pointers, branches, waits, children, and possible fibers.
entries.restrictions: Do not promise resumption in the middle of an event. Resume only from a separately specified safe checkpoint.
entries.evidence: RMXP interpreter and map engine lifecycle.

entries.identity: Game temporary state, graphics, callbacks, and live scene references.
entries.restrictions: Never encode runtime objects, callbacks, fibers, graphics, or scene references.
entries.evidence: GamePlay::Save pre-save cleanup and RMXP runtime state.

entries.identity: State registered by active plugins, including crafting.
entries.type: Plugin-defined Ruby objects with plugin-specific invariants.
entries.restrictions: Reject unless the installed plugin supplies a versioned adapter, allowed-value schema, reconstruction procedure, and migration policy.
entries.evidence: Crafting PFM extension in scripts/00000 Plugins/00001 Crafting/000_PFM.rb.

entries.identity: Save-slot binding, game version, PSDK version, and JSON schema version.
entries.restrictions: Require an exact supported schema and explicit migration. Reject unknown future versions without silently dropping fields.
entries.evidence: GamePlay::Save metadata updates and PFM::Trainer save metadata.
